summary: Completed E2E testing of ENZI Messenger iteration 192 features: Sentiment Analysis, Channel Templates (5 types), Webhook Templates (5 types), Rich Message Formatting, Kinetic Typography animations. All 20 backend tests passed. All frontend UI components verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: enzi_sentiment.py: Sentiment analysis uses keyword fallback when LLM unavailable - correctly identifies urgent/positive/negative/neutral tones
enzi_channel_templates.py: 5 channel templates (project, sprint, incident, standup, general) with pinned messages auto-creation
enzi_webhook_templates.py: 5 webhook templates (GitHub, Jira, CI/CD, Slack-Compatible, Monitoring) with sample payloads and curl examples
RichMessage.jsx: Full markdown support with react-markdown, remarkGfm, syntax highlighting via Prism (oneDark theme)
MessageBubble.jsx: Properly integrates RichMessage component for markdown rendering
index.css: Kinetic typography animations (stagger-in, scale-in, shimmer, float) and sentiment tone badges implemented

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 passed, 12 skipped due to no channels in dynamic fetch)

seed_data_creation: Created test-channel for testing. Created GitHub webhook via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features for iteration 192 are working: 1) POST /api/lumi/sentiment/analyze - returns tone (positive/neutral/urgent/negative) with keyword fallback. 2) GET /api/lumi/sentiment/channel/{id}/mood - returns channel mood distribution. 3) GET /api/lumi/templates/channels/list - returns 5 channel templates. 4) POST /api/lumi/templates/channels/create - creates channel from template with pinned messages. 5) GET /api/lumi/automation/webhook-templates/list - returns 5 webhook templates (GitHub/Jira/CI-CD/Slack/Monitoring). 6) POST /api/lumi/automation/webhook-templates/create - creates webhook with URL and sample curl. Frontend: Schedule button opens ScheduleMessageModal, Summarize button visible, Notification Settings opens modal with DND toggle/keyword alerts/per-channel mute. Sidebar Recent/New Message buttons work. Dashboard bento tiles visible with glass-card styling. Kinetic animations in CSS verified.
